headline: Open 5 AM
subtitle: Daily · 116 W MacArthur Blvd · Santa Ana
caption:
5 AM. every day. yes, even sunday.

we open before the rest of macarthur wakes up. pan dulce trays, fresh coffee, the usual.

see you at the counter ☀️

headline: Chorizo Burrito
description: Chorizo, eggs, pinto beans, and jack cheese. With hot salsa on the side.
caption:
the chorizo burrito hasn't changed since day one — there's a reason.

chorizo, eggs, pinto beans, jack cheese, hot salsa on the side. $10.50. foil-wrapped, ready to go.

order it #4 at the counter.

headline: Santa Ana's morning spot.
caption:
some people know us by 'the windmill place.' we'll take it.

116 w macarthur. open since 5 am. the usual is always coming up ☕

stop in this week — tell us your order in the comments.

headline: Pan dulce, fresh.
caption:
pan dulce arrives before sunrise. most days they're gone by 10.

conchas, orejas, polvorones — fresh from this morning's bake.

save this for your next coffee run.

headline: Still warm
caption:
if you come in by 7, they're still warm.

the whole tray, basically. conchas, pan dulce, the regulars.

set the alarm — it's worth it.

headline: Strawberry Smoothie
description: Fresh strawberries, ice, blended cold. From the licuados side of the menu.
caption:
strawberry season is here — the licuados taste like it.

real strawberries, blended cold with ice. $7.50. side of pan dulce optional but encouraged.

pair it with the #4 burrito or just sip.

headline: Stop in early.
caption:
5 am at the bakery looks like this.

trays loaded, coffee on, the front door's unlocked. 116 w macarthur blvd.

come see what's out today.
